name: Linker Hand O30
summary: Linker Hand O30 is LinkerBot's research-oriented direct-drive hand with 20 independently moving active joints. The manufacturer positions it as a platform for dexterous-operation model training and complex manipulation, combining brushless motors with a lightweight transmission structure. The official table lists a 730 g mass, CAN and CAN FD communication at 500 Hz, ±0.2 mm repeatability and a 0.8-second opening or closing time. Thumb force, other-finger force and whole-hand grip are reported separately; the model's nominal load figure is a different measure.
